blocks.text:
Continue towards the border with Costa Rica. After crossing the border, the route passes through Puntarenas province towards the central Pacific coast.

After lunch, head to the tourist town of Quepos near Manuel Antonio National Park. A sunset cruise is planned for the evening. During the yacht trip, you can relax, enjoy tropical fruit, listen to live music and admire the coast from the water.

Overnight at Parador Resort & Spa.  
**Meals:** breakfast.
